<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def nodes(): return current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
def piece_info():
    out=[]
    for n in nodes():
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==12:
            bb=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bb]; cs=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
def ghost_center():
    pts=[]
    for n in nodes():
        if n['color']=='g':
            for p in n['boundary']: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return None
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return ((min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2)
def click(r,c): action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])

print('start pieces:', piece_info())
sel = [(16,17),(16,29),(16,47)]
for i,s in enumerate(sel):
    click(*s)
    gc = ghost_center()
    print(f'sel{i+1} at {s}, ghost {gc}, pieces {piece_info()}')
    if gc is None:
        print('NO GHOST - abort'); break
    click(*gc)
    print(f'after jump{i+1}:', piece_info(), 'done:', last_action_result.get('done'), 'lvl:', last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def nodes(): return current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
def piece_info():
    out=[]
    for n in nodes():
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==12:
            bb=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bb]; cs=[p[1] for p in bb]
            out.append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return sorted(out)
def ghost_center():
    pts=[]
    for n in nodes():
        if n['color']=='g':
            for p in n['boundary']: pts.append(p)
    if not pts: return None
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    return ((min(rs)+max(rs))//2,(min(cs)+max(cs))//2)
def click(r,c): action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
